found_by: the CI fuzz smoke job (fuzz-macos), read-only mode, fourth run: AddressSanitizer heap-buffer-overflow, READ of size 4
base: a read-only mutant of a 3 MiB seed, the runner's own artifact, kept whole

edits.note: large enough that EXT4_XATTR_IHDR points past the inode buffer

symptom: ext4_xattr_ibody_find_entry read the in-inode xattr header's magic number before the bounds check that 0065 had put inside ext4_xattr_is_ibody_valid -- patch 0013 had moved that read ahead of the check so an attribute-less inode answers 'not found' rather than EIO. With the header past the inode, the magic read ran off the end of the inode-table block buffer: heap-buffer-overflow at ext4_xattr.c:843, reached from ext4b_getxattr.
fixed_by: patch 0076 -- the header is bounded against the inode before its magic is read
reproduce: build/bin/ext4dump getxattr /hardlink/mid.bin user.small # EIO with the patch; heap-buffer-overflow under ASan without it. The inode is reached through /hardlink, which the corrupt image presents as a file but the harness (and a lookup) traverse as a directory -- the tree-walk verb skips it, which is why the row names the path.
note_on_detection: A read overflow: faults only under AddressSanitizer, like fixtures 0001, 0004 and 0012.
